principles.zh: 按实际任务、动作与评价指标判断，不按论文是 benchmark 还是方法论文排除。
principles.en: Judge tasks, actions and metrics, not whether the paper proposes a benchmark or a method.

principles.zh: 有来源的代表任务可以接入；缺失预算、种子或复现设置单列为限制，不等于没有任务。
principles.en: Source-backed representative tasks may be included; missing budgets, seeds or reproduction settings remain explicit limitations.

principles.zh: 合集仅汇总已核验成员；子游戏不继承其他成员的任务或能力。
principles.en: Collections aggregate confirmed members only; child games never inherit sibling tasks or capabilities.

principles.zh: 同一维度按研究来源去重，主要与次要关联分开；不代表独立 benchmark 数量、模型成绩或 Arena 可运行状态。
principles.en: Deduplicate research sources per axis and separate primary from secondary associations; counts are not independent benchmark families, model scores or Arena readiness.

non_game_control.zh: 机器人或扫描控制，不是游戏玩家任务
non_game_control.en: Robot or scanning control, not a game-player task

protocol_missing.zh: 尚缺可核对的任务协议

scope_not_reviewed.zh: 已核验其他游戏，当前游戏尚缺协议
scope_not_reviewed.en: Protocols documented elsewhere, not for this game

capability_unmapped.zh: 任务已确认，能力尚无充分映射依据

infrastructure_only.zh: 平台或工具，需落实到具体评测协议
infrastructure_only.en: Platform or tool; concrete evaluation protocol needed

static_diagnostic.zh: 问答、预测或求解器诊断，不是玩家行动评测
static_diagnostic.en: QA, prediction or solver diagnostics, not player actions

development_generation.zh: 游戏开发、生成或渲染评测
development_generation.en: Game development, generation or rendering evaluation

definition.zh: 根据显式规则、逻辑或数值约束构造并验证有效解；仅有游戏规则不构成依据。
definition.en: Construct and validate solutions under explicit logical or numerical constraints; merely having game rules is insufficient.

definition.zh: 任务目标直接要求处理位置、连通、几何变换或布局；仅有像素输入不构成依据。
definition.en: The objective directly requires positions, connectivity, geometric transformations or layouts; pixel input alone is insufficient.
